messages.author: 04b15f8a5125f402
messages.subject: seasonal for diel
parts:
Hello

I am building a temperature model with both a daily and a seasonal signature. I have multiple measurements per hour. Can I just use two seasonal signatures, one of 24 hrs, based upon hour, and one with 365 days for the seasonal signature?

I cannot find much documentation about the seasonal model and am concerned that an annual temperature model of 8760 hours would risk masking the diel component?

Are there any good references for the seasonal model class in INLA?

Thanks
Scott Burman

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] seasonal for diel
parts:
That depends on the type of seasonality you're looking for.
The "seasonal" model is defined in inla.doc("seasonal"), but it wouldn't be my first choice for a _smooth_ seasonal model, especially not if you don't have regular data in time.
For that, I'd use a cyclic rw2 model instead, and yes, you can have a separate model component that models the daily cycle and one that models the annual cycle.
As a general advice, think about what type of model you think would be appropriate _first_, and then figure out how to implement that model with INLA (or a model close to that).

Finn
